Container.Name: hamcast
Container.Overview:
Streams amateur digital voice nets (YSF, DMR) to Icecast, receive-only. hamcast links to a reflector or DMR master as a single listen-only hotspot, decodes the audio in software, and pushes an MP3 stream per net to an Icecast server, with a dashboard showing who is talking and per-transmission recordings.
All in one: hamcast runs its own Icecast and can transcribe every transmission with a built-in Whisper. Each can be swapped for your own service with the variables below (an external Icecast URL, or any OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text URL).
Put the list of nets in config.yaml in the Config path (see config.example.yaml on the project page). hamcast identifies itself with your callsign and DMR ID: never configure someone else's.

Config.Name: Dashboard port
Config.Description: Web app: listen to each net, see who is talking and what was said, and (with the admin password) add and manage nets.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Optional config.yaml. Nets are managed in the web app; any nets in config.yaml are imported on first start.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Nets (streams.json), the transmission history (hamcast.db), recordings, Whisper models, the DMR callsign cache, generated passwords.

Config.Name: Icecast port
Config.Description: Bundled Icecast: the stream URLs listeners use (http://server:port/mount). If you change it from 8000, set Public stream URL to http://server:port. Unused with an external Icecast.

Config.Name: Callsign
Config.Description: Your own callsign. hamcast links to reflectors as this callsign, receive-only.

Config.Name: DMR ID
Config.Description: Your DMR ID plus a 2-digit hotspot suffix none of your hotspots use (e.g. 312345699). Only needed for DMR streams.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the web app's Manage pages. Empty = generated, see Data/admin-password.txt.

Config.Name: ECTLogger site
Config.Description: An ECTLogger site (e.g. https://app.ectlogger.us) whose schedules nets can follow, to link only while a net runs.

Config.Name: Keep audio (days)
Config.Description: Days to keep each transmission's recording. 0 = forever. Transcripts and details are kept forever.

Config.Name: External Icecast URL
Config.Description: Leave empty to use the bundled Icecast. Otherwise icecast://source:PASSWORD@host:8000.

Config.Name: Public stream URL
Config.Description: Base URL listeners use (e.g. https://stream.example.org). Empty = this server's address and Icecast port.

Config.Name: Icecast source password
Config.Description: Bundled Icecast. Empty = generated once and saved in Data/icecast-passwords.json. Set it to feed extra sources (e.g. BUTT).

Config.Name: Icecast admin password
Config.Description: Bundled Icecast admin pages (user admin). Empty = generated, see Data/icecast-passwords.json.

Config.Name: Transcribe
Config.Description: true to transcribe every recorded transmission.

Config.Name: Speech-to-text URL
Config.Description: Any OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint (e.g. http://10.0.0.2:9000). Empty = built-in faster-whisper on the CPU.

Config.Name: Speech-to-text model
Config.Description: Whisper model name (built-in: tiny.en, base.en, small.en, medium.en...; for a URL, whatever that server calls it).

Config.Name: Speech-to-text API key
Config.Description: Only if the speech-to-text service needs one.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns files in Data.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns files in Data.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for recording file names and the dashboard log.
